title: Mid-Career Momentum: Your Next Move
concept: A career-map route turns mid-career complexity into one practical next move and a 90-day commitment.

beats.purpose: Welcome an experienced learner who is ready for more.
Show this track as a deliberate checkpoint on a wider career map.
Preview the simple learning tools and support available.
Acknowledge pressures and frame three plausible career directions.
Focus the learner on one realistic move over 6 to 12 months.
Turn the lesson into a specific 90-day commitment and next action.
